messages.subject: Parameter mapping from the template
messages.body_plain:
In the documentation for MakeADFun it states:

More advanced parameter mapping, such as collecting parameters between different vectors etc., must be implemented from the template.

Can you point me to an example of how to parameter map in the template?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Parameter mapping from the template
messages.body_plain:
I guess an example would be:

PARAMETER_VECTOR(mu)
PARAMETER_VECTOR(beta)

vector<Type> new_mu(mu.size())
new_mu(0) = mu(0)+beta(0);
new_mu(1) = mu(0)+mu(1)+beta(1);

>From the R side you could fix components of mu and beta in different combinations.

messages.subject: Use of exp, log, etc with arrays and matrices
messages.subject_clean: Use of exp, log, etc with arrays and matrices
messages.body_plain:
Hi Group

I have been exploring the Eigen capabilities within TMB and have been able to get many of the functions to work. I am a bit stumped on the use of exp though. I have matrices and arrays for which I want to apply exp to each cell.

As seen from the attached files, exp will work on matrices converted to arrays but does not seem to work on matrices or arrays directly. I tried all sorts of combos of array() and matrix() with exp, all to not avail. I see in the TMB documentation a matexp function but have not been able to get this to work.

Any ideas?

Bob
